title: The Tale of the Merchant and His Wife

paragraphs.en: After the donkey and ox's conversation in the moonlight, the merchant and his wife went to the stable. The donkey asked the ox in their own language what he planned for the next morning and when the plowman brought fodder. The ox replied that he would pretend to be ill if given fodder, lying down and puffing his belly.
paragraphs.zh: 在月光下驴和牛的对话结束后，商人大声对妻子说：“我们去马厩看看吧。”驴用它自己的语言问牛明天早上打算做什么，以及犁夫何时会送来饲料。牛回答说，如果给它送来了饲料，它就会假装生病，躺下来鼓起肚子装模作样。

paragraphs.en: The donkey warned against this plan, revealing that the merchant had told the plowman to slaughter and skin the ox if it didn't eat its fodder. The ox then let out a fart and bellowed.
paragraphs.zh: 驴子警告说这个计划不可行，透露商人的确吩咐犁夫，如果牛不吃饲料，就把它宰了并剥皮。随后，那头牛放了个响屁，发出了一声低吼。

paragraphs.en: The merchant laughed at the donkey and ox's conversation. His wife asked, "What are you laughing at? Are you making fun of me?"
paragraphs.zh: 商人大笑起哄，听了驴和牛的对话。妻子问道：“你笑什么？是在取笑我吗？”

paragraphs.en: He denied it but admitted he couldn't reveal their secret due to fear of death. She insisted, threatening to leave him if he didn't tell her. Crying all night, she finally confronted him the next morning.
paragraphs.zh: 他否认这一切，但承认自己因为害怕死亡而无法透露他们的秘密。她坚持要他讲出来，威胁如果不告诉她就要离开他。整晚都在哭泣后，第二天早上她终于质问他。

paragraphs.en: The merchant pleaded, "Tell me why you are crying and stop questioning." But she refused, insisting on knowing the reason for his laughter. He then called their two daughters, parents, relatives, and neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 商人大声哀求：“告诉我你为什么哭泣，别再问了。”但她坚持不肯停止，非要弄清楚他笑的原因。于是，他叫来了两个女儿、父母、亲戚和邻居。

paragraphs.en: Everyone gathered, including farmhands and servants, who wept as he prepared to die.
paragraphs.zh: 众人聚集在一起，包括农夫和仆人，都在他准备赴死时流下了眼泪。

paragraphs.en: He summoned legal witnesses, wrote a will leaving his wife and children their due portions, freed his slave-girls, and bid farewell to his family. Even the witnesses wept. The merchant's wife’s parents approached, saying if he hadn't known for certain he would die, he wouldn’t have gone through this.
paragraphs.zh: 他召集了法律见证人，立下遗嘱，将应得的财产留给妻子和孩子，并释放了他的女奴。最后，他对家人依依不舍地告别。连见证人都不禁落泪。商人的岳父岳母也来了，说如果他不确定自己会死，绝不会如此决断。

paragraphs.en: But she remained firm in her resolve.
paragraphs.zh: 但她坚决不肯退让。

paragraphs.en: The merchant overheard his dog telling the rooster that their master's wife was demanding he reveal his secret, which would lead to his death. The rooster retorted that the farmer was foolish for having only one wife but not knowing how to manage her. The dog asked what he should do.
paragraphs.zh: 商人在一旁偷听到他的狗对公鸡说，主人的妻子要求他透露自己的秘密，否则就会要了他的命。公鸡反唇相讥，说农民愚蠢得很，只有一个妻子却不知道怎么管。狗问公鸡应该怎么办。

paragraphs.en: The rooster advised pushing the wife into a room, locking the door, and beating her until she promised never to ask again. Hearing this, the merchant took an oak branch, pushed his wife into a room, locked the door, and began beating her mercilessly on her chest and shoulders.
paragraphs.zh: 公鸡建议把妻子推进一间房间，锁上门，狠狠地打她直到她答应再也不提这件事。听到这番话，商人在地上捡起一根橡木枝条，将妻子推进房间，锁上门，开始毫不留情地在她的胸膛和肩膀上抽打起来。

paragraphs.en: She cried for mercy, pleading, "No, no, I don’t want to know anything." Tired of hitting her, he opened the door. His wife emerged penitent, and the merchant learned good management.
paragraphs.zh: 她哀求道：“不，不，我不想知道任何事情。”被打累了，他开了门。妻子带着悔意走了出来，商人才了解到良好的管理之道。

paragraphs.en: Everyone was happy, turning mourning into celebration.
paragraphs.zh: 大家喜气洋洋，将哀悼化为了欢庆。

paragraphs.en: The vizier's daughter said, "If you don't relent, I'll go to King Shahrayar by myself and accuse you of refusing me." The vizier asked, "Must you do this?" She replied, "Yes."
paragraphs.zh: vizier 的女儿说：“如果你不罢手，我就自己去找沙哈拉叶尔王告你。” vizier 问道：“你一定要这么做吗？”她回答道：“是的。”

paragraphs.en: Exhausted, the vizier went to the king. Kissing the ground, he offered his daughter for that night. Astonished, the king said, "How can you give your daughter knowing I'll ask you to kill her tomorrow and you too if you refuse?"
paragraphs.zh: 宰相筋疲力尽，便去找国王。他跪地吻土，提出愿将女儿献给国王一宵。国王惊讶地说：“你怎舍得女儿，要知道我明天会要求你们俩一起陪葬的。”

paragraphs.en: The vizier explained, "She refuses but insists on being with you tonight."
paragraphs.zh: vizier 解释说：“她不愿意，但坚持要和你共度今夜。”

paragraphs.en: The king was pleased and ordered the vizier to prepare his daughter. The vizier went home, repeated the message, and prepared his daughter. She packed what she needed and told her sister Dinarzad, "When I go to the king, send for you if not sleepy.
paragraphs.zh: 国王听后非常满意，命令首相准备他的女儿。首相回家后复述了这番话，并开始为女儿做准备。她收拾好必需品，对妹妹迪纳扎德说：“我去见国王时，如果没睡意就叫你过来。”

paragraphs.en: Tell a story that will stop his practice." Dinarzad agreed.
paragraphs.zh: “讲一个故事让他改掉这个习惯。”丁纳扎德应允了。

paragraphs.en: At nightfall, the vizier brought Shahrazad to King Shahrayar. When the king tried to fondle her, she cried and asked to bid farewell to her sister before daybreak. The king summoned her sister, who slept under his bed.
paragraphs.zh: 夜幕降临， vizier 带着 Shahrzad 到了国王 Shahryar 面前。当国王试图轻抚她时，她哭了起来，请求在天亮前与妹妹告别。国王便召来了她的妹妹，这位妹妹正睡在他的床下。

paragraphs.en: As the night wore on, Dinarzad woke up and suggested that Shahrazad tell a story to pass the time before they parted at dawn.
paragraphs.zh: 夜幕渐深，迪纳兹达醒来提议沙赫拉扎德在黎明前分手之前给他们讲一个故事打发时间。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad turned to the king and requested permission to speak. He agreed, and she began: "May I have your permission to tell a story?" The king said yes, and Shahrazad was pleased, saying, "Listen."
paragraphs.zh: 沙赫拉兹阿德转向国王请求讲话的许可。国王答应了，她开始说道：“我能否请您听一个故事？”国王点头同意，沙赫拉兹阿德面带微笑地说，“请听好。”
